mechanism: Weak-to-medium: implicit coercions (`==`, `+[]`). `===` and strict mode reduce the damage; they do not remove ToPrimitive.
why: Loose equality was a 1995 convenience that cannot be removed without breaking the web.
useWhen: Always, and you should pretend `==` does not exist.
price: A legendary bug farm; linters exist because the language will not save you.
